Class OfferAction

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.board.OfferAction
public class OfferAction extends Object
Immutable description of the draws and the food reward granted by an OfferTile. Captures how many cards can be picked from each row of the card market and the food rebate granted when the tile is resolved.
